🧾 Product Description
Dreame 8.1 Inch Memory Foam Spring Mattress — a hybrid bed mattress that pairs a breathable memory foam comfort layer with a silent double-coil spring system for orthopedic support. Medium-firm feel, built for neck & back support and back-pain relief.
📐 Mattress Size (W × L × H)
Single: 90 × 190 × 20.6 cm (36" × 75" × 8")
S-Double: 120 × 190 × 20.6 cm (48" × 75" × 8")
Double: 135 × 190 × 20.6 cm (54" × 75" × 8")
Queen: 150 × 190 × 20.6 cm (60" × 75" × 8")
King: 180 × 190 × 20.6 cm (72" × 75" × 8")

📋 Specifications
- Fabric: imported high-quality knitted fabric — soft, breathable, anti-bacterial & anti-dustmite
- Material: imported memory foam + high-density core foam + individually-wrapped silent coil
- Thickness: 8 inches (20.6 cm)
- Firmness: Medium (5/10)
- Coil System: dual silent coil system
- Function: breathable, dust-proof, anti-bacterial

✨ Why You'll Love It
- Memory Foam Comfort: body-contouring memory foam relieves pressure for a restful, comfortable sleep.
- Orthopedic Support: medium-firm support keeps your spine aligned — great for neck & back support and back-pain relief.
- Breathable & Fresh: multi-layer breathable foam improves airflow and wicks away sweat, keeping you cool and dry.
- Silent Springs: dual-coil system absorbs motion and noise, so turning over won't disturb your partner.
- Anti-Slip Base: point-plastic anti-skid base keeps the mattress firmly in place.
- Hypoallergenic & Baby-Friendly: anti-bacterial and anti-dustmite.
- Vacuum Roll Packed: compressed and shipped in a box for easy delivery and quick setup.
